response.rationale: I think A and B name the same business capability. "Apiary and hive registry" and "Apiary and hive registration" are close to the same name. Both are built around the same class, BeekeepingService (node 67cb7dff33e3b097). A also lists ApiaryRepository and HiveRepository, which are the storage classes that registering apiaries and hives would rely on. The only real difference is where each one sits: A comes from a group of classes that work together (community:1), while B comes from the business component. That is a difference in how the code was grouped, not in what the capability does. My confidence is not total because both groups also hold other classes, such as the treatment and report services, that belong to other capabilities.
